summary: Iter 21 — Full test of new Estimates module (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_estimates.py with 22 pytest cases covering lookups, RBAC (Admin/Accountant/SiteEngineer 200; Client/Vendor 403), CI-dedup for categories/statuses, POST validation (missing project_name/amount<=0/invalid category -> 422), delete RBAC (SE 403, Admin 204, missing 404), and upload endpoint broadened roles (Accountant + SiteEngineer 201; Client 403) — 22/22 pass in 4.23s. Frontend Playwright: logged in as Admin, navigated to /admin/estimates, verified estimates-page + estimates-table + create-estimate-button render; opened estimate-form-modal, validated empty-form disables submit, negative(-5) & 0 amounts show estimate-amount-error, filled project + phase + inline-added new category ('TEST_Landscaping_<ts>') via estimate-category-inline-form -> auto-selected in estimate-category-select, uploaded a 1x1 PNG via estimate-drawing-input -> estimate-drawing-preview thumbnail appeared, inline-added new status ('TEST_OnHold_<ts>') -> auto-selected in estimate-status-select, submitted -> success toast + modal closed + new row appears in estimates-table with drawing thumbnail and status badge. PDF flow: created another estimate uploading a small PDF; list row rendered red 'PDF' link (no img thumbnail). Cancel closes without saving. Delete: window.confirm accepted -> row removed and 'Estimate deleted' toast. Everything green.
critical_code_review_comments: estimates.py — clean, small router with proper Pydantic validation (Field(gt=0) enforces amount>0; min_length=1 for project_name). Good CI-dedup pattern (ilike). ensure_defaults() called on GET is idempotent and safe.

uploads.py — roles broadened correctly (Admin/SiteEngineer/Accountant/ProcurementOfficer). 10MB size check reads full body first — acceptable at this scale but for larger files consider streaming/chunk-check to avoid memory spike.
EstimateFormModal.jsx — good use of qc.setQueryData in onCreated callback avoiding the auto-select race that iter20 flagged for AddExpenseModal (this is the correct pattern; consider back-porting).

InlineAddSelect.jsx — reusable and clean. Note: the sentinel '__add_new__' is placed as first SelectItem; if a user presses Enter/space navigating with keyboard it could accidentally trigger — acceptable trade-off for compact UX.
EstimatesPage.jsx renders drawing without lazy-loading — for large lists consider loading='lazy'. Non-blocking.
